source_text: In Judaism, brit milah, performed on the eighth day post-birth as per Genesis 17:10-14, symbolizes eternal alliance with God and has sustained Jewish continuity amid persecution, with rabbinic authorities rejecting equivalence to FGM as it preserves sexual function and pleasure.
